description: This file contains utility functions for comparing images, buffers, and text, including image diffing with support for PNG and JPEG formats, and text diffing with colored output. It also provides a factory function to select the appropriate comparator based on MIME type.

methods.name: getComparator
methods.description: Returns a comparator function based on the provided MIME type, supporting PNG, JPEG, and plain text.

methods.name: compareBuffersOrStrings
methods.description: Compares two buffers or strings and returns a result indicating differences.

methods.name: compareImages
methods.description: Compares two images (buffers) with support for different formats and diff options, returning differences or errors.

methods.name: validateBuffer
methods.description: Validates that a buffer is a proper PNG or JPEG image based on magic numbers.

methods.name: compareText
methods.description: Compares two text strings and produces a colored diff output.
